sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 18 of 2024 registered at Police Station Isagarh, District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 376, 376 (2) (n) of the I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 and 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

Entire prosecution story is highly suspicious in the light of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. in which she clearly stated that she was in love with the applicant - accused, got married with him and left on her own volition with the Ajay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19070940/
1 applicant.

sentences.text: She further stated that they solemnized marriage and now she is seven months pregnant with the child of the applicant.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident is also doubtful in the light of the contradictory date of birth in different documents.
Further argument is that applicant is in custody since 17.1.2024.

After conclusion of investigation,
charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.

Applicant is the permanent resident of District Shivpuri (M.P.)
having no criminal antecedents a n d there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
O n the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Committal Court.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
